answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable bond that stays locked until dawn of each settlement cycle and is slashed if duplicate identities are proven. One operator can still invent many names, but every copy must lock real funds and build a slow, costly history of useful work, like water carving karst: cheap to fake one channel, expensive to fake a whole cave system. When a gale of new identities arrives, the bond plus history check pushes the attacker's cost above any voting or mining reward, while honest agents keep their stake.
